# Test fixtures (anonymised)

Generated by `pnpm fixtures:anonymise` from the real samples in `reference/`
(gitignored). Don't edit by hand.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `bank-export.xlsx` | Bank export of wallet 69811362 (1,922 transactions, 2025-01-15 → 2026-10-09) |
| `paste-active.txt` / `paste-overdue.txt` / `paste-default.txt` / `paste-complete.txt` | Phone "Business Subscriptions" tab copy-pastes |
| `paste-mortgage.txt` | Tablet "Sale Agreement – Financed" details copy-paste |

**Pseudonymised:** character names (including mentions inside comments),
State IDs, personal wallet IDs, in-game agreement IDs/UUIDs, agency name.
Mapping is consistent across files (a borrower has the same fake State ID in
the export and in every paste).

**Unchanged:** amounts, tax, timestamps, rates, transaction types, property
addresses, and the system wallets the logic depends on (`69811362` business,
`69794349` / `69833729` State, `69740396` tax escrow).

Invariant used by tests: reconstructed balance = **$185,331** (equals the export header).
